projects.title: TerraAvis
projects.desc: An AI-enabled hybrid rescue robot with a dual-mode mobility system combining aerial navigation and tracked ground movement. Integrated thermal imaging, FPV surveillance, real-time object detection and autonomous control for search-and-rescue and disaster-response scenarios.

projects.title: 4-Bit Microprocessor
projects.sub: Built from discrete logic on breadboards
projects.desc: A fully functional 4-bit microprocessor built entirely from discrete 74-series logic ICs on breadboards. Complete datapath including ALU, registers, instruction register, program counter and shared bus, with a hardwired control unit and a custom instruction set supporting arithmetic, logical, load, store and conditional jump operations.

projects.title: Friendly AI Chatbot
projects.desc: A standalone embedded AI device built around an ESP32 with real-time voice input, amplified audio output and an OLED display for feedback. Includes a custom-designed PCB and 3D-printed enclosure, with Python driving the conversational logic.

projects.title: Dual-Axis CNC Plotter
projects.sub: Motion control from G-code to paper
projects.desc: A 2-axis CNC plotter using Arduino, stepper motors and a custom mechanical frame to translate digital designs into precise physical drawings. Implemented G-code interpretation and motion-control firmware for accurate pen positioning, combining embedded systems with mechanical design.

projects.title: DOSEGUARD
projects.kind: AI Systems · Nuclear Science · Interactive Data Design : Based on IAEA
projects.desc: A standards-grounded decision engine for gamma irradiation, built on 30+ IAEA research papers and cross-referenced against each destination country's own regulatory limits (e.g. FDA 21 CFR 179.26). Generates a downloadable, accurate prescription report with tailored recommendations for your exact product and facility. Built for HackAtom Summer University 2026.
